ModMetaData.name: Nelim's Pickle Tools - Coat steps
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
Pickle steps that spawn animals of a kind and read which alternate coat (PawnKindDef.alternateGraphics) each one drew: how many different coats came out, that each index is in range, and that each animal keeps its own coat across a save and reload. For the retexture mods that add alternateGraphics to animal kinds. Developer tooling; no Defs, no features. A suite stages it with one line in a pass map. See CoatSteps/README.md at the repository root.
Developer test companion for RimWorld 1.6. Requires Pickle; no gameplay content or scenarios included. Enable only for test suites that use these steps.
